name: France
description: France from the painted caves of Lascaux and Roman Gaul to kings, revolution, empire, two world wars and the Fifth Republic.

checkpoints.name: Caves, Gaul and the Franks
checkpoints.note: People painted the caves of Lascaux in the Ice Age. Caesar conquered Gaul, Clovis united the Franks, and Charlemagne was crowned emperor.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: The Treaty of Verdun set apart the western Frankish kingdom. Notre-Dame rose, Joan of Arc fought the English in the Hundred Years' War, and Louis XIV ruled from Versailles.

checkpoints.name: Revolution and empire
checkpoints.note: The Bastille fell in 1789, the king was executed and the Terror followed. Napoleon made himself emperor, wrote a code of laws and fell at Waterloo. His nephew ruled a second empire.

checkpoints.name: The republic and two world wars
checkpoints.note: Defeat by Prussia brought the Paris Commune and a republic. The Eiffel Tower went up, the Dreyfus affair split the country, and France fought at Verdun, fell in 1940 and was freed in 1944.

checkpoints.name: The Fifth Republic
checkpoints.note: De Gaulle founded the Fifth Republic in 1958 as the war in Algeria ended. Students rose in May 68, and France took up the euro. Terror attacks struck Paris in 2015, Notre-Dame burned in 2019 and reopened, and Paris held the Olympics of 2024.
